name: qbeta-m1-rotated-index-from-blocks
description: Route C M1: S+_11(x;q) computed from the q-Hahn Bessel holomorphic blocks (GGM eq 127a/b) and checked against the printed eq (200) Laurent-in-x coefficients, plus the x=1 eq-(61) tower.

parameters.source: GGM 2012.00062v3: eq (18) fugacity basis, eq (21) dictionary, eq (127a/b) q-Hahn Bessel blocks, eq (200) explicit S+_11

data.verdict: M1 CONFIRMED — and the single q^1 discrepancy is ADJUDICATED as an ERRATUM IN THE PAPER. MATCHES: q^0 = 1; q^2 = -(x^-2+2x^-1+3+2x+x^2) EXACTLY; x=1 gives the eq-(61) tower [1,-8,-9] EXACTLY. The q^1 x-distribution differs from the printed line — computed -(x^-2+2x^-1+2+2x+x^2) vs printed -(2x^-2+x^-1+2+x+2x^2) — and an INDEPENDENT SECOND ROUTE settles it in favour of this computation: summing the DGG flux-basis index table I_{4_1}(0,e) per eq (18), Ind^rot(0,x;q) = sum_e I(0,e) x^e, yields q^1 coefficients (-2,-2,-1) — identical to this block computation, NOT the printed (-2,-1,-2); q^0 and q^2 agree with both. Both readings sum to -8 at x=1, which is why the eq-(61) tower never exposed it; only the two-variable check did. PROVENANCE: re-extracted at SPAN level (font-size 8 = superscript), confirming both the eq-(200) block arguments J(x,x^-1;q)J(x,x^-1;q^-1) + J(x^-2,x^-1;q)J(x^2,x;q^-1) — which this probe implements exactly — and the printed coefficient as read, so the difference is NOT a text-extraction artifact. CONCLUSION: GGM eq (200)'s q^1 coefficient is a typo; corrected value -(x^-2+2x^-1+2+2x+x^2). The eq-(21) dictionary target is thereby verified in-corpus as a TWO-VARIABLE identity. Worth reporting upstream. See docs/audits/2026-08-11-m1-adjudicated-erratum-and-the-three.md.
